title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Can we perform Umrah in other people's name who is muslim and alive and who can perform his own umrah at later time? 13207 views Q. Hajj expense with my wife comes to rs.3.25 lacs. Can I Do hajj(with my wife) by managing fiannace as follows : Rs.1.50 lacs my saving Rs.1.00 lacs by sold out of jwellery of my wife Rs.0.75 lacs by borrowing from my friend(interest free) Is Hajj is Farz on me in above condition? 1793 views Q. If one is in the state of Ihraam, can one touch the Ka'bah or go to the Multazam as it is fragranced? 8008 views Q. We are going for Umrah in Ramadan, in-shaAllah and would like to ask you two questions 2374 views Q. I plan to do more than one Umrah. I will be shaving off my head completely after the 1st umrah and in the 2nd umrah will not have any hair, still do I have to shave again completely 36727 views Q. I want to ask you that can we wear leather socks during Ihram in Hajj or Umrah and perform Tawaf, Sai, etc. wearing leather socks. 6928 views Q. During umrah, performing saee, i forget to do seven rounds, but i did only five round, my wife and my brother too for three umrahs unknowingly, we live in jeddah, it happend unknowingly, please tell me the kaffrah or it is forgiven done by unknowingly. 11998 views Q. Hajj 1862 views Q. As salam alaikum, Respected ulama of deoband. I stay in KSA in riyadh. If i want to go for umrah and the public transport is not going to stop such a long time in which we can go in IHRAM can we go to jeddah meeqat for going in to IHRAM. 3986 views Q. Assalam o alikum wa rehmatullah wa barakatuh. Is awoman can perform HAJJ alone or (without Mahram)your reply is awaited. Jazakumullah. 2915 views Q. Hajje-badal 4485 views Q. I am inshallah planning for my Haj this year. I plan for Haj-e-Tamattu.First of all I shall be going to Mecca and perform the Umra part of the Haj-e-Tamattu. I shall then proceed to Madina and stay there for 8-9 days. I shall then leave Madina on the 7th of Zil Haj and reach Aziziya. 8th Zil Haj morning I shall proceed to Mina-Arafat-Muzdalifa-Mina. My question is [1] when I am returning to Aziziya on the 7th Zil Haj from Madina when I wear the Ihram at the miqat Zul Hudaifa whether I should make the niyat of Haj of Tamattu only and go to MIna straight away to complete the Haj arkaans or I should again do a Umra and then go to Mina on the 8th of Zil-Haj. When I first came to Mecca from India during Zil Qayida I would have already performed one Umra ss for Haj-e-Tamattu. So is it required to perform another Umra before Haj ? Since I am returing to Aziziya only on the 7th Zil-Haj evening I will also not have sufficient time to to to Mecca to perform the Umra. [2] When I return from Madina my total duriation of stay in Aziziya and the 5 days of Haj will be aroud 9-10 days only. So sould I do Qasr of my namaaz or do Ada? 3744 views Q. If someone's wudhu breaks after 3 or 4 circle (tawaf) during tawaf then from where he will start his tawaf after making wudhu? 19272 views Q. Offering two rakaat after tawaf 13198 views Q. Assalamualykum warahmatullahi wabarakatahu, Is it compulsory to shave the head while performing Umrah ? or can i cut my hair small, kindly prove through Hadees, Jazakh Allah khair! 1803 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 27933 Country: India Title: I performed ummrah on 15-october-2010 (07 Dhul Qa`dah 1431)i stay in riyadh i never perform haj befour please let me know it is mandatory for me to perform haj this year also let me know what is the period of aiyaam of haj as i heard it start from 1st shawwal ?. secondly i have loan to pay Question: i performed ummrah on 15-october-2010 (07 Dhul Qa`dah 1431)i stay in riyadh i never perform haj befour please let me know it is mandatory for me to perform haj this year also let me know what is the period of aiyaam of haj as i heard it start from 1st shawwal ?. secondly i have loan to pay Answer ID: 27933 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2111/B=1707/tb=1431) Hajj has become fardh on you. After paying the debts when you own money to an extent that you can perform hajj, then you should go for hajj and perform it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
